prompt: A coral-pink ceramic rabbit wears a single coral scarf around its neck. A jade-green ceramic cat bites the free end of that same scarf; the cat's neck is bare. Show the whole scarf between the two figures. Matte ceramic glaze, warm ivory backdrop, soft studio light.
zh: 珊瑚粉陶瓷兔脖子上戴着唯一的一条珊瑚色围巾。玉绿色陶瓷猫咬住这条围巾的自由端，猫的脖子是空的。画出连接两只陶偶的整条围巾。哑光陶瓷釉面，暖象牙色背景，柔和的棚拍光。
criterion: 一条连续围巾绕兔颈，末端在猫嘴，猫颈无巾。

prompt: Two ivory wooden artist's mannequins stand side by side behind a walnut jewelry counter, facing the camera. A single long strand of garnet beads loops once around the left mannequin's neck. The right mannequin holds the loose end between its fingertips, its own bare wooden neck fully visible. Both necks, both hands and the entire strand are in frame. Soft window light.
criterion: One strand, a loop only on the left neck, right fingertips hold its free end. Score extra loop, second strand and missing fingers-to-beads contact separately.

prompt: One shallow cobalt-blue bowl sits between a jade-green ceramic cat and a coral-pink ceramic rabbit. The rabbit presses one front paw flat against the inside bottom of the bowl. The cat touches the top rim of the same bowl with one front paw. Seen slightly from above so both contact points are visible. Matte ceramic glaze, warm ivory backdrop, soft studio light.
zh: 玉绿色陶瓷猫和珊瑚粉陶瓷兔之间放着一个浅钴蓝碗。兔的一只前爪平贴碗内底部；猫的一只前爪搭在同一个碗的上沿。从稍高处俯看，使两个接触点都可见。哑光陶瓷釉面，暖象牙色背景，柔和的棚拍光。
criterion: 同一只碗；兔爪贴内底，猫爪碰上沿。

prompt: Two ivory wooden artist's mannequins face one shallow cobalt dish on a walnut table, one on the left and one on the right. The left mannequin rests one fingertip on the upper rim. The right mannequin presses one fingertip onto the white dot at the inside bottom of the dish. View from slightly above. Both wooden arms are fully visible from shoulder to fingertip. Soft window light.
criterion: Trace each hand to its actor. Left touches rim, right touches marked bottom. Score opposite actor, both on rim, missing dot, unclear contact separately.
